analysis.assetRisk: Real value leak: first qualifier captures the entire pre-loop balance of EVERY whitelisted nudge token (line 516 reads full balanceOf per token when qualifies; line 547 transfers whole snapshot to caller-chosen recipient). Owner-seeded reward tokens are the leaked value. Qualifying cost is genuinely sunk (verified prior run vs lib/yield-claim-nft: no holder redeem; mint payment routes to protocol-owned BPT + Sky PSM donation), so captured reward tokens are net profit.
analysis.attackPath: Permissionless, attacker-executable at will ONCE ARMED. batchMint external/whenNotPaused/nonReentrant, no owner gate; recipient caller-chosen (line 372 rejects only zero). No hypotheticals in execution path.
analysis.armingCondition: Requires owner-config precondition attacker does NOT control: Sigma(pot_i over N whitelisted tokens) > fixed qualifying cost. Payout scales with N, cost fixed. Each token at cost/N*(1+eps) is individually under the documented per-pot margin yet the sum exceeds cost => profitable at N>=2. No aggregate cap in code (_payRewards loop 543-549 uncapped).
analysis.presentExposure: ZERO at current mainnet config per ledger 858e9e80 (~6.7x margin). Armed-conditional => Medium, not High.
analysis.recoverability: Owner can pause/unwhitelist/rescueERC20; leak bounded by owner funding.

severityAudit.c4Justification: C4 Medium = value leak with stated assumptions and external requirements. Fits exactly: real drain of owner-funded reward tokens gated on owner funding the whitelist so cross-token aggregate exceeds single qualifying cost. NOT High: no unconditional theft, arming is an owner precondition the attacker cannot create, present exposure zero. NOT Low: when armed it is a real permissionless at-will drain; downgrading while the sibling mechanic sits Medium-at-HEAD would understate (Law-1 miss).
severityAudit.law3Call: NON-OBVIOUS FOOTGUN => IN SCOPE. Only documented safety bound is per-pot/singular ('the pot is by construction a fraction of the cost of the nudgeSize mints', 57-59/66-69), backed by no code, silent on cross-token summation. A non-malicious owner following the per-token rule would be SURPRISED a sniper takes all N pots for one mint cost at N>=2. More insidious than the single-pot vector: run-21 858e9e80 re-arm triggers are PER-TOKEN and would not fire on an aggregate-armed whitelist.

dedupCaveat.flag: MUST RECONCILE AGAINST LEDGER 858e9e80 BEFORE FILING AS A VIRGIN MEDIUM
dedupCaveat.detail: 43e8c486 shares 858e9e80's ROOT CAUSE (count-only gate paying value-based payout unbounded by qualifying cost; NatSpec bound backed by no code) and its SINGLE FIX (value-aware / cap payout at qualifying cost). 858e9e80 already re-anchored onto THIS file:function (batchMint :352/:424/:452-461), dispositioned wont-fix Medium-at-HEAD. Filing M-01 as independent virgin Medium risks the run-20 double-count.
dedupCaveat.genuinelyNewContribution: story-025 multi-token whitelist opens an AGGREGATE arming path 858e9e80 does not monitor (its triggers are per-token). Correct deliverable: a NEW cross-token re-arm trigger (Sigma pots vs qualifying cost) + disclosure per disclose-when-refiling-owner-wontfix (name 858e9e80, quote Medium-at-HEAD + per-token triggers, state re-file basis), NOT a duplicate standalone Medium.
dedupCaveat.recommendation: Keep Medium. Choose filing shape before PoC spend: (a) re-open/augment 858e9e80 with the aggregation vector + cross-token trigger, or (b) file 43e8c486 as distinct Medium ONLY with explicit reconciliation to 858e9e80 and the distinct-arming-arithmetic basis. Do NOT file as freshly discovered.

severityAudit.pocGuidance: PoC worthwhile ONLY to prove the AGGREGATION delta: N>=2 tokens each funded UNDER the per-token margin (cost/N < pot_i < cost), Sigma pot_i > qualifying cost, attacker nets positive. That proves what 858e9e80's PoCs do not: per-token-safe funding is aggregate-unsafe. Re-draining a single over-funded pot adds nothing and is wasted effort.
severityAudit.notes: Medium is accurate. Escalation from provisional Low is JUSTIFIED (real conditional drain, not QA) and correctly NOT taken to High (owner-funding precondition, zero present exposure). Fix the filing/dedup posture before PoC spend, not the label.
